PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.SUMMARY: Synapse is now a credible developer-tool beta with strong MyGRACE integrity, honest Linux/macOS install documentation, a declared prebuilt release matrix, local release smoke coverage, and release checksum verification.

EVIDENCE.MYGRACE_DRIFT: 0 canonical drift across 70 code modules, graph shards, and verification shards
EVIDENCE.CI_GATE: Full scripts/ci.sh gate passes, including fmt, clippy, runtime guard, tests, release smoke, verify, review, refresh, and status
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_SMOKE: Local release smoke builds locked target release binary, packages Linux/macOS named tarball artifacts, verifies checksum sidecars, extracts, and runs syn --version on runnable host targets
EVIDENCE.INSTALLER_TRUTH: Installer uses safe temporary directories, supports SYN_INSTALL_DIR, maps Linux/macOS x86_64 and arm64 hosts to declared prebuilt artifacts, verifies SHA256SUMS, and falls back to cargo source install when no prebuilt artifact exists

RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_PLATFORM_MATRIX: Linux/macOS release matrix is declared in CI, but must be validated by the next tagged GitHub release run
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_REAL_RELEASE_DOWNLOAD: Smoke validates locally packaged artifacts and workflow asset aggregation, not a live GitHub release download
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_NON_DEVELOPER_INSTALL: Source fallback still requires Rust and git, which is acceptable for developers but weak for non-developers

PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.NEXT_PHASE: Complete Phase-5 by validating a tagged Linux/macOS release run
